# Original OpenJFX alert fixtures

Generated by the repository's Java probes against the read-only Java checkout
at `D:\Data\Git\tangluobo\tomata`, using its OpenJFX/Modena runtime and source
strings. The probes construct their own scenes and inspect/fire events only on
their own nodes. They do not contact servers, load saved connections, write the
clipboard, or send operating-system input.

- `original-object-alerts.json`: five stock alerts from
  `core/tests/java/DatabaseObjectAlertsOracle.java`; content sizes, button bounds,
  default/cancel flags and resolved font names. Headerless stock alerts are
  418 × 101 for these strings; the multiline warning is 360 × 157.
- `original-button-palette.json`: 18 resolved Modena states from
  `core/tests/java/DialogButtonPaletteGolden.java`. The first 16 are the
  Cartesian product of default, focus, armed and hover. The last two verify
  disabled opacity (0.4). Background layers retain source order, insets, corner
  radii and gradient stops.
  SHA-256: `2F78E9495A8A806FFED3C02361C49A49E1A792E3A741AA099043D201D99BC56B`.

Custom `ButtonData.OTHER` confirmation buttons have no default flag. Enter
still fires one when it owns keyboard focus. Cancel handles Escape and window
close. A separate owned-node key probe verified this behavior; absence of the
default flag must not be interpreted as disabling Enter on a focused button.

These are fixture-specific geometry/CSS expectations, not proof of whole-app
visual parity. DPI, font resolution, long-text wrapping and window lifecycle
need native-window checks too. Original raster icons remain unchanged and
retain their upstream notices.
